scope_allowed: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU

models.name: Model 1 — Lesion-Crossing Dynamics (explicit FEA)
models.what_it_computes: Peak advancement force and force–displacement profile while advancing the delivery sheath across a stenotic, partially calcified segment; local vessel wall strain at the lesion contact.

models.name: Model 2 — Sheath Retraction and Release (explicit FEA)
models.what_it_computes: Transient force spike and steady retraction force during sheath withdrawal for device release; contact stick–slip behavior and energy dissipation at the device–sheath–vessel interfaces.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism A — Lesion Crossing
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Controls operator push force needed to traverse stenoses; excessive force risks vessel injury, plaque dislodgement, or sudden jump with malposition.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism B — Sheath Retraction for Release
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Determines deployment force spikes that can induce axial device shift and wall trauma during release, affecting placement accuracy and safety.

deviation.detail: All credibility factor scores are reported on a 0–12 scale (0 = none, 12 = excellent), with acceptance threshold set at 8 for each model×mechanism pair.

findings.factor: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU
spans: For crossing, the phantoms span inner diameters and stenosis fractions common to femoropopliteal interventions and embed partial circumferential calcification to replicate asymmetric loading at the lesion shoulder.
The imposed advancement speeds (5–20 mm/s) align with motion inferred from fluoroscopy in preclinical studies.
findings.span: For crossing, the phantoms span inner diameters and stenosis fractions common to femoropopliteal interventions and embed partial circumferential calcification to replicate asymmetric loading at the lesion shoulder.

spans: The modeling pipeline is managed under Git with a trunk-based workflow and protected branches.
Continuous integration runs unit tests for mesh generation, contact pairing, and IO consistency with 96% line coverage.
Containerized environments pin solver versions, li-braries and compilers to ensure reproducibility across machines.
findings.span: The modeling pipeline is managed under Git with a trunk-based workflow and protected branches.

spans: Inner lumen diameters (5.5–6.5 mm) and wall thickness (1.0 ± 0.05 mm) were achieved by casting silicone (Shore A 40) around precision mandrels and verified by CT (voxel 60 µm) and optical metrology (±0.01 mm).
Alignment was measured by dial indicators and laser trackers to within 0.2° angular misalignment and 0.1 mm translational offset.
